snippet.title: ShredDead Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4704520/ShredDead/

ShredDead is a quirky relaxing incremental zombie-shredding game focused on progression with no lose conditions. Defeat endless waves, collect loot, grow your skill tree and evolve the zombies.
